subject.title: iOS/WebChat messages append to transcript but do not trigger/deliver assistant replies

question: Do the merged `chat.send` thinking-metadata and Apple in-flight recovery fixes provide enough real iOS/WebChat proof to close this issue, or should this remain open until a fresh native-app current-main repro is run?
rationale: The code now contains plausible adjacent fixes, but the issue's exact app-originated append-without-assistant-turn path is not proven fixed and an explicit maintainer-owned live repro decision is safer than auto-closing.

options.title: Keep open for fresh iOS/WebChat proof
options.body: Use this issue as the canonical tracker until a current-main native iOS app run proves `chat.send`, agent startup, assistant persistence, and visible reply delivery all work on the same session.

options.title: Close after maintainer proof
options.body: If maintainers already have private/live proof that PRs 98855 and 100277 resolve this exact path, close with that proof and the fixing commits.

recommendation.title: Keep open for fresh iOS/WebChat proof
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the canonical tracker until a current-main native iOS app run proves `chat.send`, agent startup, assistant persistence, and visible reply delivery all work on the same session.
